name: Model VIII Animal Shock Prod
description: The Persuader, officially known as the Model VIII Animal Shock Prod, was a shock prod produced by SoroSuub Corporation. A long, narrow rod with a multi-pronged tip, the Persuader had a thick haft on its opposite end that housed its power cell and controls. Equipped with non-slip handgrips on its haft, the prod measured barely over two meters in length and required two hands to wield.
